profile.helpText: Tap the ? button on any screen for a short explanation. For login problems, ask the school office.

help.today: Your classes are listed here. Tap 'Take attendance' every morning. Green means attendance is done.
help.attendance: Everyone starts as Present. For a child who did not come, tap A (Absent); for a child on leave, tap L (Leave). Then press 'Save attendance'.
help.students: Tap a student to see details, daily diary and past years. Use 'Add student' for a new admission.
help.syllabus: Open a subject and press 'Mark as taught' after teaching a topic. The bar shows how much is done.
help.import: Download the template, fill it in Excel, upload it, check the rows, then import.
help.years: Each year keeps its own classes, attendance and syllabus. Use 'Start new academic year' at the end of the year.
help.yearsHistory: To look at an old year, choose it in the 'Academic year' box at the top. Old years can be seen but not changed.
help.rollover: This copies classes, subjects, syllabus and teachers into the new year and moves students up. Nothing is deleted from the old year.
